entries.title: 3D Neuron Forest with Firing Waves
entries.description: A floating 3D forest of neuron-like nodes (spheres) connected by translucent tubes where colored pulses travel along connections, synapses brighten on activation, connections strengthen (thicken) or weaken (fade) based on repeated pulses, and camera-hovered neurons show labels and faint particle sprays when they fire.
